MessageStrip.text: ExpandableText automatically truncates long text blocks and provides a 'More / Less' toggle link to keep UI layouts clean and readable.

ExpandableText.text: This is a brief piece of feedback that fits entirely within the standard view bounds without requiring any truncation.

SAPUI5 provides powerful controls designed for enterprise application scaling. The ExpandableText control is specifically optimized for user reviews, comments, and long-form descriptions where vertical screen real estate is constrained. Users can easily click the 'More' link to review full details or collapse the text block back down when finished reading.
